$comment: mecha-FUI design tokens v0.1. Source of truth for the QML build. Values come from design/mockup.html (Stitch export). Pixel values are for the 1920x1200 reference screen and scale with width/1920, except where marked absolute.

panel.role: solid panel fill (used when the wallpaper layer is off)

panel-glass.role: default panel fill when a wallpaper is shown. Text stays readable, wallpaper ghosts through

white.role: panel borders, header tabs, active states, huge numerals

label.role: small labels. Lightest-gray rule: never darker than this

line-dim.role: inner dividers, empty cells, inactive segments

focal.role: orange. One focal point per panel, or a warning level on a scale

ok.role: green. OK states only, used rarely

grid-overlay.role: optional background grid lines every 120px (config toggle)

font.note: The mockup used Noto Sans JP for kanji. The build prefers Noto Sans Mono CJK JP first because its glyphs are exactly double-width, which keeps kanji on the grid. Both are OFL licensed and are not bundled with the repo.

huge.use: one headline numeral or kanji per region

clock.use: top bar clock only (the one allowed exception to three sizes)

type.rule: Three sizes plus the clock. LABEL never goes below 11px absolute, even when the grid scales down.

grid.note: Vertical check: 56 + 8 + 1072 + 8 + 56 = 1200. Horizontal check: 596 + 8 + 712 + 8 + 596 = 1920. Panel edges snap to cell lines minus the shared gap.

wallpaper.note: The wallpaper is the user's own layer (hyprpaper, swww, etc). The shell never draws it. These tokens only control how the HUD sits on top of it.
wallpaper.dim_note: dim_default is the suggested darkening for the wallpaper itself, exposed as a config.json option. Tune on a real screen.
wallpaper.avoid: bright full-disk images behind small label text

hatch.use: filler cells, alert strips, bar dividers
